description: Dependency updates. What each rule does and why: docs/renovate.md.

schedule: before 6am on the first day of the month

packageRules.description: Patch updates, and minor updates of 1.0 and later: one pull request a week, "Update all non-major dependencies".
Minor updates join the weekly pull request, except below 1.0 (0.x), where a minor version may break things: those get their own.
npm releases wait 3 days: a broken or malicious release is usually pulled by then.
Major updates wait in the Dependency Dashboard until you tick them: each is a task, not a routine update.
Postgres majors need a dump and restore.
prBodyNotes: ⚠️ **Postgres major version.** The new server can't read the old data directory: the database must be dumped and restored (docs/backups.md). Merging this alone breaks the existing database.

packageRules.description: Grafana 13 used over 1 GB with these dashboards and was killed at the production limit.
prBodyNotes: ⚠️ **Grafana major version.** Grafana 13.2 grew past 1 GB with these dashboards and was killed at the production memory limit (docs/monitoring.md, "Versions"). Measure its memory before merging.

packageRules.description: NestJS majors: every @nestjs/* package moves together, and an upgrade is a project, not a click.
prBodyNotes: ⚠️ **NestJS major version.** Read the migration guide (docs.nestjs.com → Migration guide) and the release notes of each @nestjs package here. Expect code changes; run the integration tests and start the app.

packageRules.description: Sign-in libraries: a major can change a token, hash, code or email without breaking the build. A note says which tests prove it still works.
prBodyNotes: ⚠️ **Sign-in library, major version.** It can change tokens, password hashes, two-step codes or emails without failing the build or the unit tests. Before merging, run the integration suites that exercise it (the pre-push hook does not): `pnpm test:services:up`, then `pnpm test:integration -- auth oauth two-step email` (docs/renovate.md).

packageRules.description: Node's major version is in the Dockerfile, .nvmrc and @types/node: one pull request for all of them.
prBodyNotes: ⚠️ **Node.js major version.** Use an LTS release (even-numbered, and marked LTS on nodejs.org; a new even version becomes LTS in October). Keep the Dockerfile, `.nvmrc` and `@types/node` on the same major.

packageRules.description: GitHub Actions: one pull request for all of them, majors included (their majors rarely need changes here).
The runners' Ubuntu version (runs-on): on request, like other majors; a new one can change the preinstalled tools.
The security overrides in pnpm-workspace.yaml stay within the major version the parent package asks for: never a major there.

customManagers.description: Images named in commands, which the built-in managers don't read: package.json scripts, scripts/*.sh, the workflow's run steps.
Images given as a compose variable's default: ${BACKUP_POSTGRES_IMAGE:-postgres:16.2-alpine}.
